note: Domains whose reporting earns the green 'Verified' badge in the app. A source NOT on this list is still kept and still linked — it just shows unbadged. The list controls a trust signal, not whether a topic can cite something.
matching: A domain matches itself and any subdomain, so "thehindu.com" covers "www.thehindu.com". Matching is on the registrable domain only — never on a path, so a hostile path on a listed domain cannot inherit the badge.
